name: Sit up in bed
event_end: trunk upright and held for 1 s

name: Leave the bed and walk away
Fall while getting out of bed
event_start: first loss of balance after standing
event_end: body on the floor and still for 2 s

name: Slide or roll out of bed to the floor
event_start: body starts to leave the mattress without standing
event_end: body on the floor and still for 2 s

name: Fall from sitting on the edge
event_start: first loss of balance while sitting on the edge
event_end: body on the floor and still for 2 s

name: Fall backwards after a step
event_start: Sitting on the exit-side edge, stands, one step away from the bed, turns to face the camera, loses balance backwards: lands sitting, then on the back, knees up.

name: Trip and fall forward
event_start: Walks along the exit side towards the head end, 0.8 m from the bed, trips at the third step and falls forward, face down.

name: Fast roll out of bed
event_start: Lying near the non-exit edge, a fast roll over that edge; lands on the right side between the bed and the table, head beside the table.

name: Slide off the edge to the floor
event_start: Sitting on the exit-side edge, slides forward slowly, then the legs give way: ends sitting on the floor against the bed side, legs out.

name: Knees give way beside the bed
event_start: Standing beside the bed at its head end (exit side), the knees give way: kneels, then tips onto the right side, curled, close to the bed.

name: Turn onto the side in bed
Sit on the edge then lie back down
Quick sit-down on a chair
event_start: Sits down quickly on a chair beside the bed; no fall.

name: Blanket slides to the floor
event_start: Patient in bed under a blanket moves her legs; the blanket slides off the exit side and stays on the floor.

name: Visitor leaves a bag on the floor
event_start: Visitor walks in from the door side, puts a bag on the floor beside the bed (exit side), walks out.

name: Sits on a chair
event_start: Sitting on the edge, stands, walks to the chair at the head end, pulls it along the bed, turns and sits on it.

name: Nurse kneels beside an occupied bed
event_start: Nurse walks in, kneels on the floor beside the bed for about 3 s reaching to the floor, stands, walks out; the patient stays in bed.

name: Puts on slippers
event_start: Sitting on the edge, bends down for about 3 s to put on slippers (feet on or near the floor), sits up; never leaves the bed.

name: Walks out of view
event_start: Gets out of bed (from lying) and walks out of view towards the door; the bed is left empty, nothing on the floor.
